category_edits.rationale: Learn bounded item-specific norms between 0.75 and 1.25, initialized at 1.0, while retaining the shared 128-dimensional input/output embedding table. This may capture item-specific confidence while preserving the GRU backbone, scoring, loss, optimizer and history policy across all four datasets.

response.change_summary: Add jointly trained bounded item norms with zero padding and tied embeddings. Update checkpoint metadata and the embedded predictor loader consistently; retain one model per dataset and all existing training settings.
